Hi Priya,

I saw Zorven is looking for a UI/UX Designer Intern to help build storefronts and dashboards, which caught my eye given my background in product workflows.

During my time as a UI/UX Designer at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings directly back into user flows and interface usability.

You can see how I approach these problems in my Bounceless case study (https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/), which demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists.

Would you be open to a quick look at that case study, or a brief chat this week?

Ananya Saini
